entries.title: agent_conversations
entries.summary: Actor-owned corporate agent conversation with capability-specific validated context and a bounded execution lease.

entries.title: agent_turn_traces
entries.summary: Optional content-level AI trace of one turn, written only when IA_MNS_AI_TRACE=content: model/prompt identifiers, timings and token counts, routing and interpretation decisions, structured conversation state before and after, and the executed query filters. Never result rows, response prose, credentials or provider payloads. Used to reproduce failures and derive evaluation candidates.

entries.title: agent_turns
entries.summary: One user message and its execution lifecycle, real progress, and versioned assistant outcome. Failed/interrupted turns retain no fabricated answer.

entries.title: identity_audit_events
entries.summary: Append-only audit of security-relevant identity events: sign-in outcomes, provisioning, link and unlink, credential and factor changes, role and grant changes, session revocation and bootstrap.

entries.title: identity_capability_grants
entries.summary: Explicit capability permissions granted to a Person by an owner, in addition to provider-policy grants derived from active links. The language model never creates grants.

entries.title: identity_external_identities
entries.summary: A link between a Person and one stable external account (PDT Connect identitySubject or Sankhya CODUSU) under a fixed issuer, created from a server-verified proof by the account holder or by an owner selecting the account in the Sankhya directory.

entries.title: identity_local_credentials
entries.summary: Optional IA-MNS local sign-in: unique login, memory-hard password verifier, lockout state and encrypted TOTP secret for strong authentication.

entries.title: identity_persons
entries.summary: An IA-MNS Person: the single internal identity that owns conversations, preferences, links, credentials, roles and grants, independent of the surface or method used to sign in.

entries.title: identity_recovery_codes
entries.summary: Single-use second-factor recovery codes, stored only as SHA-256 hashes of high-entropy values shown once.

entries.title: identity_role_assignments
entries.summary: Internal IA-MNS roles assigned to a Person. owner is the principal administrator with full IA-MNS capability and administration, independent of Sankhya or PDT roles.

entries.title: identity_security_policies
entries.summary: The single owner-administered authentication policy: session lifetime, inactivity timeout, recent-authentication windows, second-factor requirement and remembered browsers. Absent row means the built-in secure defaults.

entries.title: identity_sessions
entries.summary: Authenticated continuity for a Person: method, surface, assurance and expiry. Direct-URL sessions hold a rotating refresh credential (hash only); embedded sessions have none and renew through a new host proof.

entries.title: identity_tickets
entries.summary: Short-lived single-use flow state addressed by the SHA-256 of a high-entropy secret: bootstrap, enrollment, reset and link invitations, pending second factor, pending TOTP setup, provisioning choice, profile consolidation, and pending PDT or Sankhya proofs (state, nonce, PKCE verifier).

entries.title: identity_trusted_devices
entries.summary: A browser that completed the second factor for a Person and asked to be remembered; its HttpOnly cookie holds a random token stored here only as SHA-256.

entries.title: identity_used_assertions
entries.summary: Replay protection for host identity assertions: SHA-256 of each accepted assertion jti until it expires.

entries.title: ErrorNotice
entries.summary: Displays a public API failure message and an optional reload action.

entries.title: SalesResults
entries.summary: Presents validated sales aggregates, distinct units, comparisons and matched products.
